theory.target: Test and retire the proposed shortcut from degree-two peeling to width-two tree decompositions within triangle-free even-hole-free graphs, using rim-subdivided wheels and independent fill-edge/minor/decomposition certificates. This is not a replacement for the incomplete parent fragment.
definitions: A hole is an induced cycle of length at least four; triangle-free and even-hole-free include exclusion of C3 and C4 respectively.
Degeneracy is minimum maximum remaining degree under vertex deletion without fill; treewidth elimination first cliques the remaining neighborhood.
A tree decomposition covers vertices and edges and makes each vertex occurrence set a connected subtree; width is maximum bag size minus one.
A K4 minor certificate has four nonempty disjoint connected pairwise-adjacent branch sets.
W(l_0,...,l_(k-1)) has a chordless rim of sum(l_i) vertices and a hub adjacent at cumulative sector endpoints, with k>=3 and l_i>=2.
Finite quantifier: all 1344 ordered instances with k in {3,4,5} and every l_i in {2,3,4,5}; these are not isomorphism classes.
assumptions: Finite simple undirected graphs; a hole is induced of length at least four, including C4.
A wheel is a chordless rim cycle plus one hub adjacent to specified rim vertices; only rim edges are subdivided.
Every sector has at least two edges, so the hub has no adjacent rim neighbors and the graph is triangle-free.
Peeling deletes vertices without fill; treewidth elimination adds a clique on remaining neighbors.
The tested implication is a proposed derived shortcut, not a claim attributed to the prior cycle or primary paper.
The general bisimplicial-vertex theorem is not proved here; no parent solution or novelty claim.
approaches_considered: Reuse degree-two deletion orders as width-two filled orders: retired by a 10-vertex counterexample and the first fill-degree overflow.
Separate degeneracy and treewidth using explicit peeling, K4-minor and width-three path-decomposition certificates.
Independently optimize filled elimination with a dynamic program over all eliminated subsets of the witness.
falsification_targets: Degree-two peeling implies width-two filled elimination.
Odd spoke count alone ensures even-hole-freeness.
Odd sectors alone ensure even-hole-freeness regardless of rim parity.
The family-specific width-three construction applies to every triangle-free even-hole-free graph.

claims.statement: The 10-vertex wheel W(3,3,3) is triangle-free and even-hole-free, with degeneracy 2 and treewidth 3; explicit K4 branch sets and width-three bags certify the distinction.
claims.falsification_condition: An induced even cycle or triangle, invalid order/minor/decomposition, or exact filled-elimination optimum different from 3.

claims.statement: A degree-two peeling order in a triangle-free even-hole-free graph implies treewidth at most two.
claims.falsification_condition: A graph in that class with degeneracy 2 and treewidth greater than 2; W(3,3,3) is the supplied witness.

claims.statement: All 1344 ordered wheel parameter instances agree across sector formulas and generic cycle enumeration; 40 eligible instances have checked minor, peeling and decomposition certificates.
claims.falsification_condition: A missing parameter, mismatched table hash, or failed certificate.

claims.statement: For arbitrary k>=3 and sector lengths at least 2, these rim-subdivided wheels have treewidth 3 and degeneracy 2; they are even-hole-free exactly when k and every sector length are odd. The ordinary argument lacks independent author/kernel review.
claims.falsification_condition: An additional induced cycle, failure of the generic bag/minor construction, or a gap in the all-size argument.

claims.statement: Cameron et al. v1 Section 5 distinguishes triangulation width from deletion degree; its Figure 1 discussion already reports a stronger triangle-free even-hole-free K5-minor example. The packet is not a new structural bound.
claims.falsification_condition: Wrong graph class, locator, version or attribution.

progress.summary: An explicit triangle-free even-hole-free graph has degeneracy 2 but treewidth 3, retiring a proposed width-two substitute for the structural dependency.
A complete wheel parameter table discriminates the two parity requirements and supplies 40 proof certificates.

checks.method: Generic induced-cycle search and exact torso dynamic programming precede family confirmation; triangle, even-sector, even-rim, C4 and K4 controls test boundaries.
checks.independence_basis: Verifier authored and baseline run before theory.py. Fresh Python -I and empty environment reconstruct all expectations before certificate read. Generic simple-cycle/chord search, batched core peeling and eliminated-set torso dynamic programming differ from sector formulas, single-vertex peeling, minor lower bounds and explicit bag upper bounds. Same-assistant authorship and shared specification; no independent human/model/kernel review.
checks.result: Witness has only cycle lengths 5,5,5,9, degeneracy 2 and exact treewidth 3; all boundary controls distinguish the specified conditions.

checks.method: Reconstruct the 1344-row table, optimize all witness elimination orders via 1024 states and 5120 transitions, then semantically check every minor/order/bag certificate and seven mutations.

progress.summary: Exact filled-elimination optimization independently confirms the obstruction and semantic validators check the 40 new graph-theoretic certificates.

unresolved_objections: Same-assistant authorship/shared specification; no independent human/model or kernel proof review.
The all-size family argument, treewidth/minor facts and elimination equivalence remain ordinary mathematical dependencies; finite enumeration alone does not prove them.
The canonical AIM fragment needs human scope review; the general bisimplicial-vertex proof was not independently audited.
This retires a proposed shortcut, not the prior list-coloring corollary; a family-specific width-three certificate is not a global width bound.
A stronger minor obstruction already appears in primary literature; no novelty, parent solution or imported-status change.

next_step: Retire width-two/no-fill tree-decomposition shortcuts. Seek human scope review and independently authored verification of the actual bisimplicial dependency; do not treat further wheel enumeration or this family-specific width-three certificate as a global structural advance.
